info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API facilitates the execution of specialized operational tasks within the contact center framework of the banking channel. This API allows authorized users to initiate various actions that enhance operational efficiency and service quality. Common use cases include managing customer inquiries, processing transactions, and addressing service requests. Target consumers of this API include contact center agents and banking system integrators looking to streamline their operational workflows.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for channel-specific contact center operations.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create operational actions tailored for specific channels within the contact center framework. It facilitates enhancing operational efficiency and responsiveness by enabling the definition of actions most relevant to the channel being utilized.
